meta.source: Original demonstration scripts written for LINGUA. No audio files yet — the browser's text-to-speech is used as a preview.

exercises.title: Ordering at a café
exercises.transcript: Barista: Good morning! What can I get you? Customer: Hi, can I have a large cappuccino, please? Barista: Of course. Would you like anything to eat? Customer: Yes, a blueberry muffin. How much is that? Barista: That's six pounds twenty. Is that to take away or to have here? Customer: To have here, please. Barista: Great. Take a seat and I'll bring it over.

questions.prompt: What size coffee does the customer order?
The customer takes the order away.

exercises.title: Weekend plans
exercises.transcript: Tom: Are you doing anything this weekend, Maria? Maria: I was going to go hiking, but the forecast says it's going to rain all Saturday. Tom: That's a shame. What about Sunday? Maria: Sunday looks better, so I've moved the trip. On Saturday I'll probably stay in and finally finish that book I started last month. Tom: Sounds relaxing. If you need company on Sunday, I'd be happy to join. Maria: Really? That would be great. We're meeting at the station at eight.

questions.prompt: Why did Maria change her plans?
What will Maria do on Saturday?
Tom offers to join the hike.
